compatibility: Current valid fixtures transfer+Z onto+Z-wound target faces even when original target normals were-Z. Empty config remains disabled; valid transfers need no fallback.
kind: read-only design advice, not implementation verification
limits: No claim of geometry repair or visual acceptance

recommendation: Reject a transferred base-body corner normal outside its own geometric face hemisphere in plan_normal_continuity, before adapter mutation. Keep unchanged input corners and intentionally authored fin normals out of this policy.
